info.title: Commute Mood API
info.description: Backend API for commute mood reports, heatmaps, routes and trends.

tags.name: Heatmap
tags.description: Read and refresh commute mood heatmap cells.

tags.name: Routes
tags.description: Compare routes and read route-query history.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Submit commute mood reports for heatmap aggregation.

tags.name: Commutes
tags.description: Complete commutes and read commute trend summaries.

parameters.description: Optional device identifier for route history

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Map zoom level used for cell size

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Map zoom level used for cell size

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone for grouping daily points

RouteCompareRequest.description: Route comparison request with origin and destination

recommendation.description: Human-readable recommendation for the next commute

recommendAlternative.description: Whether the alternative route should be preferred

ScoredRoute.description: Route candidate with stress scoring metadata

stressExposure.description: Accumulated stress exposure along the route

fastest.description: Whether this route is the fastest candidate

leastStressful.description: Whether this route is the least stressful candidate

ReportRequest.description: Mood report submitted from the map

tag.description: Primary mood tag for this report

reportedAt.description: Client-side report timestamp; defaults to server time when omitted

HeatmapCell.description: Aggregated heatmap cell for map rendering

count.description: Number of reports in this cell

dominantTag.description: Most frequent mood tag in this cell

CommuteCompleteRequest.description: Completed commute feedback for trend tracking

selectedScore.description: Stress score of the selected route

fastestScore.description: Stress score of the fastest route

alternativeLabel.description: Alternative route label when one was shown

alternativeDurationRatio.description: Alternative route duration divided by fastest duration

completedAt.description: Completion timestamp; defaults to server time when omitted

selectedScore.description: Stress score of the selected route

fastestScore.description: Stress score of the fastest route

alternativeLabel.description: Alternative route label when one was shown

RouteQueryHistory.description: Stored route comparison query and result

date.description: Calendar date in the requested timezone

averageStress.description: Average end-of-trip stress for the day

commuteCount.description: Number of commutes completed on this day

totalCommutes.description: Total commutes in the requested window

averageStress.description: Average end-of-trip stress across the window

sampleSufficient.description: Whether there is enough data for a reliable trend
